fullContent:
Malatyadi Tailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Kshudraroga Adhikara 
 Introduction 
 Malatyadi Tailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of fruitful herbs. This formulation is known to treat ailments related with scalp and hairs. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Malati (Jasminum grandiflorum) 
 Karaveera (Nerium indicum) 
 Naktamala (Pongamia pinnata) 
 Agni (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Coconut oil 
 
 Usage 
 
 This formulation used for external purpose. 
 Took appropriate amount of oil and applied on the scalp. Massage with this oil. 
 Took the hot water head bath after an hour. 
 
 Or 
 
 Took the oil and applied overnight. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Premature baldness 
 Dandruff 
 Alopecia 
 Hair fall in extreme 
 
 Contraindications 
 Not meant to be taken orally. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
